indications_and_usage: Uses： For hand sanitizing to reduce bacteria on the skin.
warnings: Warnings: For external use only. Flammable. Keep away from fire and flame.
when_using: When using this product，do not use in or near the eyes.In case of contact，rinse eyes thoroughly with water.
stop_use: Discontinue use if irritation or redness develops.
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: Keep out of reach of children.If swallowed，get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
dosage_and_administration: Directions: Squeeze small amount in your palm and briskly rub hands together until dry.
inactive_ingredient: Inactive Ingredients: Water, Glycerin, Carbomer, Fragrance, Triethanolamine, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Vitamin E, Iron Oxide（CI77499), Iron Oxide(CI 77492), D&C Red No.30.
